# ReputationFlow

> Ask every customer for an honest public review. One link, a QR code, and optional private feedback. No review gating.

Site: https://tryreputationflow.com
Sitemap: https://tryreputationflow.com/sitemap.xml

## Main pages

- [How to get more Google reviews for a trade · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/how-to-get-more-google-reviews-for): Trade-by-trade guides for more Google reviews: when to ask, text and email wording, one follow-up, and a public reply when a review is already up.
- [How to respond to negative Google reviews · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/how-to-respond-to-negative-google-reviews): How to respond to a negative Google review, with templates you can edit. Reply in public, move the details offline, and do not offer a reward for changing the review.

- [Free Google review tools · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/tools): Free tools for a Google review link and a QR code, plus a printable card. No account. The template pack and the guides sit next to them.

## Compare
- [Birdeye alternative for small businesses · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/compare/birdeye): Birdeye is a multi-location reputation platform and does not list a flat monthly price. ReputationFlow is $20 a month for a review link and QR code.
- [Grade.us alternative for a small shop · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/compare/grade-us): Grade.us is review software agencies white-label for clients. ReputationFlow is $20 a month for a shop that wants the review link and QR code itself.
- [NiceJob alternative for small businesses · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/compare/nicejob): NiceJob lists Starter at $75 a month and Pro at $125 for SMS and email review marketing. ReputationFlow is $20 a month, with a free plan and no texts.
- [Podium alternative for small businesses · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/compare/podium): Podium bundles reviews with texting, phones, chat, and payments, and its pricing page says to talk to sales. ReputationFlow is $20 a month for the review ask.

- [How many Google reviews do I need to rank? · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/guides/how-many-google-reviews-to-rank): Google does not publish a minimum review count for local ranking. What to work on instead of chasing a number nobody has published.
- [How to ask customers for reviews · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/guides/how-to-ask-customers-for-reviews): Scripts for asking a customer for a Google review in person, by text, and by email, without a star target or a discount.

- [Is it legal to incentivize Google reviews? · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/guides/incentivizing-reviews-ftc-rules): What the FTC review rule and Google’s policies mean if you want to offer a discount, gift, or free service for a review. Not legal advice.

- [When to ask for a Google review · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/guides/when-to-ask-for-a-google-review): Ask after the customer has seen the finished work, once, and not in the middle of a complaint or a sale.

## How To Get More Google Reviews For
- [How to get more Google reviews for auto repair · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/how-to-get-more-google-reviews-for/auto-repair): Ask for an auto repair Google review when the keys go back and the invoice is paid. Comeback timing, and a reply that keeps the bill off the page.
- [How to get more Google reviews for dentists · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/how-to-get-more-google-reviews-for/dentists): Ask for a dentist Google review at checkout, out of the chair. Leave treatment names out, send one afternoon email, and do not confirm care in a reply.
- [How to get more Google reviews for electricians · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/how-to-get-more-google-reviews-for/electricians): Electricians should ask when the device works, and after the green tag on permitted work. Scripts, one text, and a reply that does not recap the hazard.
- [How to get more Google reviews for HVAC · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/how-to-get-more-google-reviews-for/hvac): Ask for an HVAC Google review after the customer feels the air. One same-day text, and a return visit when a review says the house is still hot.
- [How to get more Google reviews for landscapers · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/how-to-get-more-google-reviews-for/landscapers): Landscapers should ask at the install walkthrough, not the sales visit. One text when the crew leaves, and a reply if plants or drainage are the complaint.
- [How to get more Google reviews for lawn care · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/how-to-get-more-google-reviews-for/lawn-care): Lawn care reviews come after a visit the customer can see, not after every mow. Wording for the first month, a cleanup hanger, and a skipped week.
- [How to get more Google reviews for plumbers · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/how-to-get-more-google-reviews-for/plumbers): When plumbers should ask for a Google review, wording for the driveway, a text, and an email, and how to answer a review that says the leak came back.
- [How to get more Google reviews for restaurants · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/how-to-get-more-google-reviews-for/restaurants): Restaurants should ask once, when the check lands, at every table. Dine-in and takeout wording, no free dessert, and a reply for a wait or a wrong dish.
- [How to get more Google reviews for roofers · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/how-to-get-more-google-reviews-for/roofers): Ask for a roofer Google review at the ground walkthrough, after the nails are up. One invoice text, and a public reply that leaves the claim off the page.
- [How to get more Google reviews for salons · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/how-to-get-more-google-reviews-for/salons): Salons should ask at the mirror, then stop. One afternoon email for color, a correction before the ask, and a reply that does not bargain.

- [Dentist review request text template · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/review-request-text/dentist): A dentist review request text template and email that thanks the patient for the visit and leaves the treatment out. Copy the message and send it yourself.
- [HVAC review request text template · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/review-request-text/hvac): An HVAC review request text template and email for after the system is running. Fill in the company and the Google review link, and name the visit before you send it.
- [Plumber review request text template · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/review-request-text/plumber): A plumber review request text template and the matching email. Fill in the business name and Google review link, then send one message after the water is back on.

- [Salon review request text template · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/review-request-text/salon): A salon review request text template and email for after the cut or color. Fill in the stylist, the salon, and the Google review link. You send it.

## Tools
- [Google review link generator · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/tools/google-review-link): Free Google review link generator. Paste a Place ID or a Maps URL and get the official write-a-review URL, plus a QR code you can download. No account.
- [Google review QR code generator · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/tools/qr-code): Free Google review QR code generator. Paste a Place ID or a Maps URL and download a scannable QR code plus the official review link. No API key and no account.
- [Google review request message generator · ReputationFlow](https://tryreputationflow.com/tools/review-request-message): Free Google review request message generator. Type a business name, a trade, and a review link to copy a text and an email. Nothing is sent.
